semantic/dependent_type.cpp retains D<T> as current-instantiation qualifier while its inherited type is unknown. The dependent path and type-access recipe have canonical type/source identities; definition-time known names still use their bound class scope.

semantic/template_class.cpp defers argument-position/default decisions after a fixed-position source expansion; type/value category is checked at the expansion boundary. The dependent application retains its tuple identity and cannot complete while dependent.

semantic/template_call.cpp substitutes the class argument sequence with the existing immutable frame/expansion lanes. The applied template then canonicalizes its fixed parameters and pack tail; type, specialization, query and selected member caches remain TU-owned typed indices.

semantic/template_type_access.cpp checks each recipe/frame once, including ambiguity caused by dependent bases. Completed class member lookup is memoized; in-progress lookup does not publish a completed-member cache entry.

Existing selected calls, object uses and scalar conversions feed lowering/expression.cpp, typed LowIR constructors, then the explicit writer. The supplied PA17 backend is invoked by validation only; production compilation never consumes its output.
allocation: Source regions/identifiers/type and query records/specialization frames live in existing TU-owned arenas, vectors and flat indices; no ownership graph, rendered key or token replay is added.
